purpose: Requirements for searching documents bundled with forge by keyword, feature name or natural language, so users and skills can find needed built-in docs without knowing their location.
summary: Overview: make bundled forge docs searchable without knowing their locations
Preconditions: forge installed; works without doc-link/doc-db backends; users build no index
FNC-001: search via /forge:query-forge-rules, returning a Required documents: path list
Returned paths start with plugins/forge/ and callers map them to the real install location
No matching document yields a header-only list, not an error
FNC-002: semantic selection, include doubtful documents, never miss relevant ones
FNC-003: search only; no writes, commits or Issue updates; imperative input treated as search task
Out of scope: project rules and specs search handled by query-db-rules and query-db-specs
Error case: missing built-in index is unrecoverable, reported without returning a list
tasks: Implementing or changing the query-forge-rules skill
Designing built-in document index and search behavior
Reviewing search output format and consistency with query-db skills
Writing tests for built-in docs search
Implementing forge skills that look up bundled norms before work
title: REQ-035 forge 内蔵ドキュメント検索 要件定義書
